sources.note: Glottolog's only descriptive reference for niti1249 (ref 312452, pp. 11-13). Locates Nitita (Viar area, NE slopes of Levarmas Peak), two elderly speakers in Khatbol in 2004, and states p.12: 'The only published information on this variety is a collection of about thirty kin terms in Deacon (1934:125), though in 2004 I recorded just under 500 items of basic vocabulary.' Gives 11 comparative Nitita words (p.13) and notes bilabial trills and a possible /k/-/x/ contrast in Nitita (pp. 25-26, 30). No Nitita phonology and nothing on Nitita stress.
